_meta.name: Metronic Design System
_meta.description: Complete design guidelines for replicating the Metronic admin UI in a Laravel 12 project. All values extracted directly from demo1 assets and component source files.

designPrinciples.philosophy: Professional enterprise admin UI. Clean, purposeful, data-first. Every element earns its place.
designPrinciples.tone: Corporate precision softened by tasteful color and generous whitespace. Neither austere nor playful.
designPrinciples.density: Medium-high information density. Cards tile the page in Bootstrap 12-col grids with consistent 24px gutters.
designPrinciples.depth: Flat with selective elevation. Cards use subtle box-shadows only, never aggressive drop-shadows.
designPrinciples.motion: Minimal. Transitions exist only for drawers, modals, and dropdown menus (fade/slide). No gratuitous animation.
designPrinciples.iconography: Duotone icons exclusively (ki-duotone prefix). Icons have 2–4 SVG path layers for depth. Never use emoji or flat single-color icons for UI actions.
designPrinciples.darkMode: Supported natively via data-bs-theme attribute on html element. Default is light mode.
designPrinciples.responsiveness: Mobile-first. Sidebar collapses to off-canvas drawer on mobile. Header adapts, grid columns stack.
designPrinciples.accessibility: Semantic HTML, aria-labels on interactive controls, focus rings preserved.

colorPalette._note: Extracted from style.bundle.css hex frequency analysis and dark-sidebar.html layout HTML.

brand.primaryLightBg: bg-light-primary class — translucent primary tint used for icon badges and stat backgrounds

typography._note: Google Fonts Inter loaded via CDN. All weights 300–700.

scale.fs-6: 1rem (16px) — Default body, table data, form labels
scale.fs-3x: 3rem (48px) — Large icon displays, empty state icons

usageRules.pageTitle: fs-3 fw-bold text-gray-800 in toolbar, not inside card
usageRules.cardTitle: fs-3 fw-bold or card-title class (rendered as h3)
usageRules.formLabel: fs-6 fw-semibold text-gray-800 mb-2 (class: required for required fields)
usageRules.badgeText: fs-8 or unscaled — badge font is tiny, relies on padding

spacing._note: Bootstrap 5 spacing scale. 1 unit = 0.25rem (4px). Max value used is 20 = 5rem (80px).
spacing.cardBodyPadding: p-9 (36px) or auto from Bootstrap card defaults
spacing.sectionGutter: gy-5 (20px vertical), gx-5 (20px horizontal) for dashboard rows

borderRadius._note: Metronic uses a consistent gentle rounding. Never sharp corners, never pill-only.
borderRadius.symbol: varies — symbol-circle for circle avatars, default for rounded square

shadows._note: Minimal usage. Elevation is communicated via border, not shadow depth.
shadows.cardHover: Slightly elevated on hover in card-style widgets
shadows.dropdown: Metronic menu-sub-dropdown uses a structured dropdown shadow
shadows.principle: Use shadow sparingly. Cards float subtly. Avoid multiple shadow layers.

appShell.structure: Fixed header (top) + Fixed sidebar (left) + Scrollable main content area
appShell.bodyClasses: data-kt-app-layout='dark-sidebar' data-kt-app-header-fixed='true' data-kt-app-sidebar-enabled='true' data-kt-app-sidebar-fixed='true' data-kt-app-sidebar-hoverable='true' class='app-default'

header.contents: Logo (mobile), horizontal nav menu (desktop), search, notifications, user avatar dropdown
header.navStyle: Horizontal mega-menu with hover dropdowns. Menu items: fw-semibold, text-gray-800. Active item uses text-active-primary and underline indicator.

sidebar.logoArea: Logo at top of sidebar, white or light variant
sidebar.menuStyle: Vertical stacked menu. Sections separated by headings (text-uppercase fs-8 fw-semibold text-muted). Items: px-3 py-2. Active item has left accent color bar and bg-hover.
sidebar.expandBehavior: Hoverable — sidebar expands to show labels on hover when in icon-only mode
sidebar.activeColor: text-primary or text-white with bg-active class on hover/selected

toolbar.position: Between header and content. Contains page title + breadcrumb + CTA buttons.
toolbar.innerClass: app-container container-fluid d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between flex-wrap

contentArea.paddingY: py-5 or default Bootstrap container padding
contentArea.gridSystem: 12-column Bootstrap grid. Standard dashboard rows use col-md-6, col-xl-4, col-xl-3 combinations.

grid.gutter: gx-5 gy-5 (20px each direction) for dashboard card rows

dashboardPatterns.fourColumn: col-xl-3 col-md-6 — 4 stat cards per row (desktop)
dashboardPatterns.twoColumn: col-xl-6 — 2 wide cards or chart + table side-by-side
dashboardPatterns.fullWidth: col-12 — full-width chart or table widget

card.description: Primary content container. Used for all sections, tables, forms, widgets.

variants.default: card shadow-sm — lightweight shadow, white background, rounded-10px
variants.flush: card card-flush — no top border on card-header, firmer separation from page
variants.bordered: card card-bordered — visible border instead of shadow
variants.dashed: card card-dashed — dashed border, used for empty states or add-new targets

structure.header: card-header — flex row with card-title (h3) left + card-toolbar right. Min-height 70px.
structure.body: card-body — main content area. Padding typically p-9.

card.title: fs-3 fw-bold text-gray-800 or .card-title class
card.toolbar: Right-aligned flex area for action buttons, filters, menus
card.designNotes: Never nest cards. Use card-flush when card sits inside another padded container. Always give cards a title unless it is a pure widget/chart.

button.description: All interactive actions use btn base class with a type modifier.

sizes.tiny: btn-xs — not a Bootstrap default, Metronic custom, ~28px height. Use in table rows.

types.solid: btn-{color} — fully filled background. e.g. btn-primary, btn-danger
types.light: btn-light-{color} — light tinted background with colored text. e.g. btn-light-primary
types.outline: btn-outline btn-outline-{color} btn-active-light-{color} — transparent with border
types.icon: btn-icon — square icon-only button, requires btn-{size} for dimensions

hoverEffects.elevateUp: hover-elevate-up class — slight upward translate on hover

button.loadingState: Add data-kt-indicator='on'. Wrap label in .indicator-label and spinner in .indicator-progress span.
button.withIcons: Place ki-duotone icon before text inside button. Icon size should be fs-2 or fs-3.
button.crudPattern: In table rows: btn-xs btn-primary (view), btn-xs btn-info (edit), btn-xs btn-danger (delete via form submit)
button.designNotes: Never use bare anchor tags for actions. Primary page CTA uses btn-primary. Secondary uses btn-light. Destructive uses btn-danger or btn-light-danger. All buttons inside cards should be btn-sm or default; never btn-lg inside card toolbars.

variants.themed: alert-{color} — colored left accent + light tinted background
variants.solid: alert-dismissible bg-{color} d-flex flex-column flex-sm-row — fully colored bg, white text

alert.withIcon: ki-duotone icon at fs-2hx with me-4. Icon color matches alert type.
alert.dismissible: position-absolute close button (top-0 end-0) with ki-cross icon
alert.flashMessages: alert-success for session message, alert-danger with ul.list-unstyled for validation errors

variants.light: badge-light-{color} — tinted background — most common in tables
variants.circle: badge badge-circle — round indicator, used for notification counts

badge.designNotes: Use badge-light-{color} for status columns in tables. Use badge-circle for notification bubbles on icons. Font size is tiny — let padding define the badge size.

table.theadClass: text-start text-muted fw-bold fs-7 text-uppercase gs-0
table.checkboxColumn: form-check form-check-sm form-check-custom form-check-solid — use data-kt-check and data-kt-check-target for select-all
table.actionColumn: Last column, right-aligned. btn-xs buttons with @can gates.
table.datatables: Initialize with $(#id).DataTable() in scripts section. Table ID must follow kt_table_{resource} pattern.
table.designNotes: dashed rows (table-row-dashed) are the default Metronic style. They feel lighter than bordered. Always wrap in table-responsive. Align all cells middle. Status values use badge-light-{color} chips.

form.fieldWrapper: fv-row mb-7 — required by FormValidation.js for error targeting
form.label: fs-6 fw-semibold mb-2 text-gray-800 — add class 'required' for required fields (shows CSS asterisk)

inputClasses.solid: form-control form-control-solid — filled gray background, no border visible at rest
inputClasses.flush: form-control form-control-flush — no border, no background

validation.invalid: Add is-invalid class to input, show div.invalid-feedback

form.select2: form-select data-control='select2' data-placeholder='...' — always include empty first option
form.uploadImage: div.image-input.image-input-empty with data-kt-image-input='true'. Edit/cancel/remove action labels.
form.dropzone: div.dropzone.needsclick with dz-message containing ki-file-up icon + heading + sub-text
form.designNotes: form-control-solid is the default inside cards. form-control (plain) is for lighter contexts. Always pair fv-row + mb-7 on every field group. Required asterisk is CSS-only via the 'required' class on the label.

modal.closeButton: btn btn-icon btn-sm btn-active-light-primary ms-2 — inside header, uses ki-cross fs-1 icon
modal.designNotes: Modal close button is never an × character — always a ki-cross icon inside btn-icon. Modal titles are h3.modal-title. Footers always have at least two buttons.

tabs.designNotes: Line tabs are standard. Stretch tabs (nav-stretch) fill available width evenly — used in profile page header navs. Tab panes always use fade transition.

accordion.designNotes: Accordion buttons are always fs-4 fw-semibold. Content inside accordion-body can contain any HTML including forms.

breadcrumb.linkItem: breadcrumb-item > a (plain anchor, inherits muted color)
breadcrumb.designNotes: Breadcrumbs live in the toolbar below page title. Use breadcrumb-separatorless with bullet separators in profile-style headers.

symbol.description: Avatar/symbol component for user images or text initials
symbol.designNotes: Initials are always uppercase first letter only. Background color should use light variants (bg-light-primary) with matching text color. Add symbol-circle for round avatars.

separator.designNotes: Use my-5 to my-10 for spacing. Dashed separators are used inside card bodies and menu sections.

pagination.prevNext: page-item previous / page-item next — use <i class='previous'> and <i class='next'> inside link
pagination.laravelIntegration: Use x-metronic.base.pagination :paginator=$records — OR $records->links() wrapped in div.row > div.col

drawer.description: Slide-in side panel. Alternative to modal for forms/filters that need context.
drawer.interior: card.w-100.rounded-0 with card-header (title + close btn) and card-body.hover-scroll-overlay-y
drawer.closeButton: btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-active-light-primary — ki-cross fs-2
drawer.designNotes: Drawer content should always use the card structure inside. Body scrolls independently via hover-scroll-overlay-y.

stepper.itemClass: stepper-item mx-2 my-4 (+ current for active step)
stepper.iconClass: stepper-icon w-40px h-40px — contains stepper-check + stepper-number
stepper.jsInit: new KTStepper(element) — listen for kt.stepper.next and kt.stepper.previous events
stepper.designNotes: Steppers use pill-style indicators (circles with numbers). The check icon (fas fa-check) replaces the number on completed steps. Step content panels use flex-column and data-kt-stepper-element='content'.

menu.panelClass: menu menu-sub menu-sub-dropdown menu-column menu-rounded menu-gray-600 menu-state-bg-light-primary fw-semibold py-3
menu.designNotes: Menu panels always use bg-white with border. Trigger button and menu panel are sibling elements — Metronic JS connects them via the data attributes. Never position menu panels with manually written CSS z-index.

dropdown.description: Simple Bootstrap dropdown — only use for basic cases. Prefer Metronic menu for styled dropdowns.

toast.customClass: The toast uses Metronic-themed styling via style.bundle.css

swalAlert.buttonStyling: Always set buttonsStyling: false and use customClass.confirmButton: 'btn btn-primary'
swalAlert.designNotes: Never use browser default confirm(). Use Swal.fire() for all confirmation dialogs.

statsWidget.description: KPI metric card — single number with context
statsWidget.structure: card.bgi-no-repeat + card-body with: title link (fw-bold text-muted text-hover-primary fs-4) > metric value (fw-bold text-{color} my-6 fs-2hx) > description (text-gray-900-75 fw-semibold fs-5)
statsWidget.countup: Large numbers use data-kt-countup='true' data-kt-countup-value='{n}' for animated counting
statsWidget.designNotes: Stats widgets never have card headers. The title is a link inside the card-body. Color drives the semantic meaning (success=green, danger=red, primary=blue).

profileCard.description: User profile header with avatar, name, role, stats grid, progress bar, and nav tabs
profileCard.onlineDot: position-absolute translate-middle bottom-0 start-100 mb-6 bg-success rounded-circle border border-4 border-body h-20px w-20px
profileCard.metaItems: d-flex align-items-center text-gray-500 text-hover-primary — icon (fs-4 me-1) + text
profileCard.statBadge: border border-gray-300 border-dashed rounded min-w-125px py-3 px-4 me-6 mb-3
profileCard.navTabs: nav nav-stretch nav-line-tabs nav-line-tabs-2x border-transparent fs-5 fw-bold
profileCard.designNotes: Profile cards have no card-header. All content is inside card-body.pt-9.pb-0. Nav tabs sit at the bottom of the card body, flush with the card border.

chartWidget.chartFill: Gradient fills preferred over solid. Area charts use opacity 0.2 at bottom.
chartWidget.toolbarButtons: btn-sm btn-color-muted btn-active-color-primary — for chart period selectors (1M/3M/1Y)
chartWidget.designNotes: Charts sit flush inside card-body. Height defined by parent container. Use ApexCharts as the primary charting library.

dataTable.jsInit: $("#id").DataTable() or new DataTable initialization in scripts section
dataTable.theadRowClass: text-start text-gray-500 fw-bold fs-7 text-uppercase gs-0
dataTable.customButtons: Extend dtButtons array. Bulk delete button: btn-danger with AJAX POST to massDestroy.
dataTable.designNotes: DataTables inherits Metronic styling via style.bundle.css. The dashed table-row-dashed gives it a modern, editorial look. Never add borders manually.

indicator.description: Loading state on buttons during async operations
indicator.usage: Set data-kt-indicator='on' on the button element
indicator.designNotes: Always include both spans. The Metronic JS toggles visibility automatically based on data-kt-indicator attribute.

overlay.description: Hover overlay on images/cards with action buttons
overlay.overlayLayer: overlay-layer bg-dark bg-opacity-25 — absolutely positioned over content
overlay.designNotes: Use for image galleries, product cards, or any hover-to-reveal interaction.

pulse.usage: Add pulse class to btn-icon link. Include span.pulse-ring inside.

countup.description: Animated number count-up on page load
countup.initialValue: Set inner text to 0 — JS replaces on load

icons.pathCount: 1–22 paths depending on icon complexity. Always include ALL path spans.
icons.solidVariant: ki-solid prefix — single-color, no path children needed
icons.colorClasses: text-primary, text-success, text-danger, text-warning, text-info, text-gray-{n}, text-muted, text-white
icons.criticalRule: Never omit <span class='pathN'> children on ki-duotone icons. Missing paths = invisible icon segments.

pageLoad.loader: div.page-loader with span.spinner-border.text-primary inside body — auto-hidden by KTApp
pageLoad.countup: Numbers animate on first viewport entry via data-kt-countup
pageLoad.theme: Theme mode (light/dark) read from localStorage on page load before render to prevent flash

navigation.sidebarToggle: Mobile: btn with id kt_app_sidebar_mobile_toggle + ki-abstract-14 icon
navigation.sidebarHoverable: Desktop: sidebar expands from icon-only to full on hover when data-kt-app-sidebar-hoverable='true'
navigation.headerMenuDropdown: Metronic JS triggers on hover (lg) or click (mobile). data-kt-menu-trigger attributes drive behavior.
navigation.activeLinks: Active state applied by Metronic JS based on current URL. menu-here-bg for parent, text-active-primary for the link.

dataLoading.blockUI: KTBlockUI on parent container — shows spinner overlay over card/table during load
dataLoading.skeleton: Not a standard Metronic pattern — use BlockUI instead
dataLoading.emptyState: Card with dz-message–style empty state: large icon (fs-3x), heading (fs-5 fw-bold), subtext (fs-7 text-muted), CTA button

formSubmission.validation: FormValidation.js triggers on submit. Invalid fields get is-invalid class + error message below.
formSubmission.loadingButton: Set data-kt-indicator='on' on submit button before AJAX. Remove after response.
formSubmission.successFeedback: Swal.fire success or toastr.success — never browser alert()
formSubmission.errorFeedback: Swal.fire error or toastr.error — never browser alert()

confirmDelete.pattern: form[method=POST] with @method('DELETE') + onsubmit='return confirm(...)' — OR Swal.fire for better UX
confirmDelete.sweetalert: Swal.fire({ icon: 'warning', showCancelButton: true, buttonsStyling: false, customClass: { confirmButton: 'btn btn-danger', cancelButton: 'btn btn-light' } })

formPattern.create: <form method='POST' action='{{ route(...) }}'>@csrf ... fields ... submit button</form>
formPattern.update: <form method='POST' action='{{ route(...) }}'>@csrf @method('PUT') ... fields ... submit button</form>
formPattern.delete: <form method='POST' action='{{ route(...) }}' onsubmit='return confirm(...)'>@csrf @method('DELETE')<button type='submit'></button></form>

laravelIntegration.authorization: @can('{resource}_{action}') gates wrap ALL CRUD UI elements
laravelIntegration.translation: trans('global.{key}') and trans('cruds.{model}.{key}') for all user-facing strings
laravelIntegration.validationErrors: automatic in layouts.admin — session('message') for success, $errors for validation
laravelIntegration.jsScope: All page-specific JS goes in @section('scripts') @parent block. Never inline in @section('content').
laravelIntegration.idConvention: kt_ prefix on all JavaScript-targetable element IDs

darkModeGuidelines.toggle: data-bs-theme='light' or 'dark' on html element. Metronic reads from localStorage.
darkModeGuidelines.sidebarNote: Dark sidebar layout has dark sidebar regardless of light/dark mode toggle. The sidebar background (#1E2129) does not change.
darkModeGuidelines.bodyNote: Content area bg changes: #F9F9F9 (light) → dark gray (dark mode)
darkModeGuidelines.componentAdaptation: Metronic components auto-adapt via CSS custom properties. No manual dark mode class toggling needed.

do: Use x-metronic.card for every page section
Use fv-row mb-7 wrapper for every form field
Use ki-duotone icons with ALL path spans
Use btn-xs for table row CRUD actions
Prefix all JS-targeted IDs with kt_
Gate all CRUD UI with @can directives
Use trans() for all user-facing strings
Use table-row-dashed for the standard table style
dont: Never use browser confirm() or alert()
Never use inline styles except chart container heights
Never nest card components inside each other
Never add btn-lg to buttons inside card toolbars
Never use @symbol spans for icons — always ki-duotone
Never omit path spans on duotone icons
Never put CRUD action links outside @can gates
Never use TailwindCSS classes — this is a Bootstrap project
Never use multiple shadow layers on a single element
Never hardcode color values in blade files — use Bootstrap/Metronic utility classes
